entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to transition from 5GMM-IDLE to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, establish user-plane resources for PDU sessions, or transfer user data via control plane in CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message variant used for control plane service requests.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by AMF to accept service request.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message sent by AMF to reject service request.

entities.name: T3517
entities.description: Timer started when SERVICE REQUEST or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST is sent, stopped upon receiving SERVICE ACCEPT, SERVICE REJECT, or AS indication.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE has an active connection to the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: State indicating that a service request procedure is already ongoing.

entities.name: Service Request Attempt Counter
entities.description: Counter that limits the number of service request attempts when no response is received from the network.

entities.name: 5U1 UPDATED and TAI in TAI list
entities.description: Condition requiring UE's 5GS update status to be 5U1 UPDATED and current TAI to be in TAI list.

entities.name: No ongoing 5GMM specific procedure
entities.description: Condition requiring no other 5GMM specific procedure to be ongoing.

relations.description: Service request procedure involves sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure involves sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Sending SERVICE REQUEST message starts timer T3517.
Sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message starts timer T3517.
Receiving SERVICE ACCEPT message stops timer T3517.
Receiving SERVICE REJECT message stops timer T3517.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE state for initiation in many scenarios.
Successful service request procedure establishes 5GMM-CONNECTED state.
Service request procedure initiation is guarded by condition that 5GS update status is 5U1 UPDATED and TAI is in TAI list.
Service request procedure initiation is guarded by condition that no other 5GMM specific procedure is ongoing.
Service request procedure cannot be initiated if UE is already in 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Service request procedure uses service request attempt counter to limit attempts.
